title: Boxed parsing into fresh ragged rows
summary: A compiled stream applies NumberUtils.toInt to each token and allocates independent boxed output rows even where inputs alias.

change.description: A compiled stream applies NumberUtils.toInt to each token and allocates independent boxed output rows even where inputs alias.

notes: The primary grid has 187 explicitly specified matrices of up to three rows. The larger named fixture checks all 28 pairs of rows, sibling isolation, and a value-correct memoizer that violates freshness.

The exhaustive JVM companion visited 33,729 matrices over all inputs and all realizable row aliases within height three, width two and the five-token alphabet. The four bootstrap sites include a primitive int result that the SAM exposes as Integer.
